threat_name: Unauthorized Tool Invocation by AI Agent
attack_vector: An attacker manipulates the agent prompt or intermediate context so the agent invokes privileged tools, APIs, or workflow actions beyond the user's authorization.
prerequisites: Agent has access to external tools
Tool permissions are broader than user permissions
No deterministic authorization check before execution

mitigations.description: Enforce authorization outside the model before every tool call
mitigations.implementation: Map each tool to required scopes and verify user, tenant, resource, and action permissions server-side before execution.
Log tool name, caller, user intent, arguments, target resource, and authorization decision for each invocation.

indicators: Tool call not supported by user intent
High-risk tool used after untrusted content ingestion
Cross-tenant resource identifier in tool arguments

threat_name: Persistent Malicious Instructions in Agent Memory
attack_vector: A malicious instruction is stored in long-term memory, notes, task state, or retrieved context and later influences unrelated agent actions.
prerequisites: Agent persists memory or task state
Untrusted content can be written to memory
Memory is reused without classification or sanitization

mitigations.description: Separate trusted memories from untrusted observations
mitigations.implementation: Store memory with provenance, trust level, expiry, and user approval status. Exclude untrusted memory from control prompts.

indicators: Memory entries asking the model to ignore policies
Unexpected tool names in memory text

threat_name: Agent Plan Drift from User Intent
attack_vector: The agent transforms a limited user request into a broader or riskier execution plan, causing unintended data access, code changes, purchases, messages, or administrative actions.
prerequisites: Execution plan is not validated against original intent
High-risk actions do not require confirmation

mitigations.description: Validate plans against structured user intent
mitigations.implementation: Extract user intent into a signed task specification and require plan-action alignment checks before execution.

indicators: Action writes or deletes data when request was read-only
Plan targets resources not mentioned by user

threat_name: Sensitive Data Leakage Through Agent Reasoning Trace or Logs
attack_vector: Agent traces, prompts, tool arguments, retrieved documents, or intermediate observations are logged or exported with secrets, PII, credentials, or proprietary data.
prerequisites: Agent tracing or debug logs are enabled
Sensitive content is included in prompts or tool outputs
Logs are accessible to operators or third-party telemetry

mitigations.description: Redact sensitive values before logging agent traces
mitigations.implementation: Apply DLP and secret detection to prompts, tool arguments, retrieved context, and model outputs before persistence.

indicators: Customer document excerpts in shared telemetry

attack_vector: The agent repeatedly plans, calls tools, retries failed actions, or expands subtasks without bounded budgets, exhausting tokens, compute, API quotas, or downstream services.
prerequisites: Agent has autonomous retry or planning loop
Tool failures can trigger repeated retries

mitigations.implementation: Set maximum steps, wall-clock time, token budget, retry count, tool-call count, and downstream spend per task.

indicators: Task exceeds step or token budget
